response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT f.rating, AVG(f.length) as avg_length, AVG(f.rental_rate / f.rental_duration) as per_day_price FROM film f WHERE f.length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.rating), cross_rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) as mean_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) as avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(rs.per_day_price) as avg_of_per_day_prices, AVG(rs.per_day_price - crm.mean_price) as avg_excess FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean crm WHERE rs.per_day_price > crm.mean_price
